mapper.sql: select p.pool_id, p.station_id, p.buyer_id, p.gas_type, p.total_in, p.reserved, p.consumed, p.adjusted, p.alert_threshold, p.alert_armed, p.update_time, s.station_code, s.station_name, bu.buyer_name, (p.total_in + p.adjusted - p.consumed - p.reserved) as available from gas_inventory_pool p left join gas_station s on p.station_id = s.station_id left join gas_buyer bu on p.buyer_id = bu.buyer_id
mapper.select: select p.pool_id, p.station_id, p.buyer_id, p.gas_type, p.total_in, p.reserved, p.consumed, p.adjusted, p.alert_threshold, p.alert_armed from gas_inventory_pool p where p.station_id = #{stationId} and p.gas_type = #{gasType} for update

select p.pool_id, p.station_id, p.buyer_id, p.gas_type, p.total_in, p.reserved, p.consumed, p.adjusted, p.alert_threshold, p.alert_armed from gas_inventory_pool p where p.pool_id = #{poolId} for update
mapper.update: update gas_inventory_pool set total_in = total_in + #{qty}, update_time = sysdate() where pool_id = #{poolId}
update gas_inventory_pool set reserved = reserved + #{qty}, update_time = sysdate() where pool_id = #{poolId}
update gas_inventory_pool set consumed = consumed + #{qty}, update_time = sysdate() where pool_id = #{poolId}
update gas_inventory_pool set adjusted = adjusted + #{qty}, update_time = sysdate() where pool_id = #{poolId}
update gas_inventory_pool set alert_threshold = #{alertThreshold}, alert_armed = 1, update_time = sysdate() where pool_id = #{poolId}
update gas_inventory_pool set alert_armed = #{alertArmed}, update_time = sysdate() where pool_id = #{poolId}
